deduplicated_all_assay_inventory_bound.identity_definition: Exact reference-target sequence SHA256 plus reference-validated genomic SNV identity; assay/cell/time/library identity excluded
deduplicated_all_assay_inventory_bound.interpretation: Finite observed-source squared-loss bound, conditional on identical provided sequence/variant inputs. It includes estimator noise and experimental context; it is not a biological irreducibility claim or a population Bayes-error estimate.

double_counting_policy: Each pair is reported separately. The inventory calculation includes every source assay accession at most once; overlapping TERT pairs are not pooled as independent measurements.

pairs.inference_limit: Repeated-library, time, cell and perturbation comparisons are source diagnostics. Differences include estimation noise; a technical repeat in another element is not an element-specific causal noise baseline.

quality_rule: Finite score; tags>=10; finite positive DNA/RNA counts; retain partial positions
scientific_scope: Same-study source estimates across selected elements and contexts, not independent laboratories or the entire human genome.
score_unit: squared log2 reporter-effect coefficient for MSE; original log2 coefficient for means/MAE
